messages:
maria: quick sync — need to lock SOC2/ISO launch acceptance criteria for audit exports / BYOK / retention by EOD Friday. Customers pushing for legal-hold snapshots & tenant-level retention. Who's owning the checklist?

kevin: I can draft a checklist. High level: evidence export schema, proof of authenticity (signed manifests), retention TTLs, KMS escrow handshake, and canary pilot signoff. Any must-haves from legal?

sofia: storage cost note: long retention for audits -> tiering required. propose: hot (90d), warm (1yr), cold (7yr). Need SLOs for export latency for hot vs cold.

elliot: ops ask: SLA for audit export job = 99.9% within 2h for <=5GB, 24h for larger. Also need legal-hold override that bypasses TTL; define revoke flow.

maria: +1 on legal-hold. For BYOK: we need acceptance tests for key rotation, revocation, and escrow retrieval. Customers expect key custody proof.

kevin: sketch of export payload (inline):
```json
{
  "tenant_id": "t-123",
  "time_range": {"from": "2025-01-01", "to": "2025-02-01"},
  "events": [...],
  "manifest": {"sha256": "...", "signed_by": "redwood"}
}
```
We should include `kms_key_id` and `encryption`: `AES-GCM`.

sofia: can we require exports to be encrypted in transit + at rest? BYOK customers will insist on CMEK and HSM-backed wrappers.

ops-bot: https://intranet.redwood/runbooks/audit-export (auto)

elliot: Also, need rollback plan if export fails mid-stream — resumable exports and idempotent chunks.

maria: launch gates proposal (short):
- M1: Schema & API stable + unit tests
- M2: Pilot with 2 enterprise customers (AcmeCorp, FleetOps)
- M3: KMS escrow + legal signoff
- M4: GA with retention tiers & monitoring
Who can take ownership of M2 pilot?

kevin: I can shepherd pilot. Will reach out to AcmeCorp & FleetOps today. ETA pilot kickoff: next Tue.

sofia: fine. I'll prepare cost model and retention toggle UI mocks.

elliot: I'll add SLA metrics to Console dashboard & set alerts. Question: do we allow tenant-initiated immediate export vs ops-only? That impacts auth.

maria: prefer tenant-initiated with admin RBAC + audit trail. ops-only as fallback for legal holds.

kevin: noted. I'll produce the checklist doc this afternoon and post link.

maria: closing — thanks. posted checklist link: https://docs.internal/redwood/compliance/export-checklist
